series.name: Sahm Rule
series.asOfNote: 3mma UNRATE minus prior-12m min of 3mma; trip >= 0.50

series.name: Real M2 Growth
series.asOfNote: M2 YoY minus CPI YoY, aligned by month

series.name: M2 Growth
series.asOfNote: constructed: year-over-year percent change of FRED M2SL (monthly, billions USD)

series.name: Monetary Base YoY
series.asOfNote: constructed: year-over-year percent change of FRED BOGMBASE (monthly, billions USD)

series.name: Bank Loans YoY
series.asOfNote: constructed: year-over-year percent change of FRED TOTLL (weekly; nearest week ~1y prior)

series.name: Money Multiplier
series.asOfNote: constructed: M2SL / BOGMBASE, aligned by month (fiduciary-media / multiplier proxy); history p90=4.46

series.name: Excess Money
series.asOfNote: constructed: M2 YoY minus nominal GDP YoY, aligned by month (Friedman: money vs spending)

series.name: Materials / Consumer IP
series.asOfNote: constructed: IPMAT / IPCONGD, aligned by month (Mises/Hayek higher-order vs consumer goods)

series.name: Credit / GDP
series.asOfNote: constructed: (TCMDO millions USD / 1000) / GDP billions USD. TCMDO is $ millions, GDP is $ billions; ratio is a multiple of GDP. TCMDO is NSA, GDP is SAAR.

series.name: Gold / Silver
series.asOfNote: constructed: Yahoo gold USD/oz divided by silver USD/oz (conventional gold/silver ratio = oz silver per oz gold)

series.name: U minus NROU
series.asOfNote: constructed: UNRATE minus NROU (CBO natural rate, clipped to present), aligned by month (Friedman natural-rate gap)

series.name: PPI minus CPI YoY
series.asOfNote: constructed: PPIACO YoY minus CPIAUCSL YoY, aligned by month

series.name: Fed Balance Sheet
series.asOfNote: constructed: FRED WALCL (millions USD, Wednesday level) divided by 1,000,000 → trillions USD
